content.comment_body: Hello, I was unable to connect the I4 input to the Q1 output (top terminal); I received an 'incompatible connectors error' when trying to link them. Is it not possible to set up a simple OR function? Thanks in advance!
Please see the attached video for guidance.

analysis.insight_summary: The user ran into an 'incompatible connectors error' when trying to link the I4 input to the Q1 output to create an OR logic function. The issue was quickly resolved after consulting a recommended video, suggesting the problem was related to understanding the tool's usability or feature rather than a technical bug.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily connect input and output terminals using logical operations such as OR, without facing connector compatibility errors.
